notes:
REF-BM-02: Saving performs no remote metadata collection.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are inserted as new records without guidance or convergence to editing.
REF-BM-07: List items show title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but notes are neither stored nor searched.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed; tag filtering is only available through the sidebar.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact-match searches.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No separate unread view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action support.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot be applied to the full currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results are always ordered by creation date descending; no sort-key selection is available.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and Markdown rendering are unsupported.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot functionality exists.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is unsupported.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archiving does not.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
